# Data Source: stripe_tax_code

A Stripe tax code, which classifies what a product is for tax purposes. Look one up by its `id`, such as `txcd_10000000`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_tax_code" "general_services" {
  id = "txcd_20030000"
}

resource "stripe_product" "consulting" {
  name     = "Consulting"
  tax_code = data.stripe_tax_code.general_services.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the tax code to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `description` - A detailed description of which types of products the tax code represents.
* `name` - A short name for the tax code.
* `requirements` - An object that describes more information about the tax location required for this tax code. Some tax codes require a [performance location](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/location-sales#required-versus-optional-performance-locations) to calculate tax correctly. See [`requirements`](#requirements) below.

<a id="requirements"></a>
### `requirements`

The `requirements` attribute supports:

* `performance_location` - Describes whether a performance location is required for a successful tax calculation with a tax code. Possible values: `optional`, `required`.
